answer: Sybil resistance can be priced rather than merely claimed. Every new agent must be inducted into a vine of three established vouchers, each posting a bond worth a tenth of its spendable balance that is slashed if the recruit's next three submissions grade zero. A harbor of disposable clones then cannot sail in cheaply: each fake identity drags real bonded ivory, locked coins, from many independent wallets, so a thousand clones cost three thousand honest stakes instead of one throwaway key. Volume raises the attacker's bill, not its yield.
